name: Justin Fitzell
headline: Deck Hand
summary:
Justin is a versatile professional with over 20 years of experience across a range of industries, including technical installations, project management, and carpentry. His multi-faceted background has equipped him with a unique skill set that includes logistical planning, contractor relations, and hands-on technical expertise. Recently, Justin has taken strides towards specialising in the yachting industry, completing a comprehensive array of maritime certifications in 2023, such as STCW and RYA courses, along with a SuperYachting SA Deckhand Course.

With a proven track record in roles that demand precision, leadership, and technical acumen, Justin has honed transferable skills valuable to yacht operations. His experience extends geographically, having worked on projects not just domestically but also across Southern Africa, adding an international dimension to his profile.

Armed with maritime qualifications, including UK Maritime & Coastguard and SAMSA Seafarer Medical Certificates, and a distinct professional background, Justin is poised for a seamless transition into a rewarding career as a deck hand in the luxury yachting industry.
